notes.title: Update 1.1.6
notes.notes:
ver 1.1.6
* Add a mode button. "Snake Mode" : New units will try to avoid the defensive building.

ver 1.1.5
* Supports a cwd when the game is launched from Steam App.

ver 1.1.4
* Add screenshot menu. Can save PNG, animation GIF. etc.

ver 1.1.3
* Add looser's assistance. Can select old stages. Adjust the difficulty. etc.

ver 1.1.2
* Bug fix. Added a version to menu.

ver 1.1.1
* Add [Pause/Restart] Button.
